images.caption:
Lorenz National Park's specialty lies in its diverse ecosystem. Stretching from the peaks of snow mountains to the coast, you can find swamps, forests, to grasslands. There are several types of rare animals that inhabit this national park, including the Pesquet parrot. This rare bird has a plain black head to the chest, with a red belly and wings for the male and the female has no red spots behind her eyes.
The name Lorentz was taken from a Dutch traveler named Hendrikrus Albertus Lorentz who visited the area in 1909. While in Papua, he held three expeditions, namely in 1903, 1907, 1909-1910.
In addition to the national park, the name Lorentz is also attached to the name of the river or also known as the Undir River.

Papua always surprises people with the natural wealth hidden in its forests. Lorentz National Park is representative of the gradation of ecosystems with the highest peak of Cartenz and its eternal snow.
